title: Rogues Gallery
paragraphs: Private-eye drama featuring Richard Rogue, a tough detective whose cases often take an unusual turn after he is knocked unconscious and consults his wisecracking alter ego, Eugor, on 'Cloud Eight.'

Hard-boiled private-eye series centered on Richard Rogue and his knockout-induced alter ego Eugor. Frozen GRH preservation contains 23 Dick Powell-era files plus one Barry Sullivan episode. Surviving collector numbering and specialist logs disagree on several program numbers/dates; those conflicts are represented rather than normalized away.

GRH documents the program through Mutual Dick Powell run (June 23, 1945 to June 13, 1946) on [[org|org.09b709d4bde5c263|Mutual Broadcasting System]], NBC Dick Powell summer run (June 23, 1946 to September 22, 1946) on [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]], and NBC Barry Sullivan summer run (June 8, 1947 to August 31, 1947) on [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]].

Among the most extensively documented contributors in the GRH holdings are [[person|dick-powell|Dick Powell]] (performer on 23 recordings), Peter Leeds (performer on 18 recordings), Dee Englebach (director on 17 recordings and producer on 16 recordings), Leith Stevens (composer on 17 recordings and conductor on 17 recordings), Ray Buffum (writer on 16 recordings), Jim Doyle (announcer on 14 recordings), and [[person|gerald-mohr|Gerald Mohr]] (performer on 8 recordings).

The program is also connected in the archive to [[org|org.09b709d4bde5c263|Mutual Broadcasting System]] (broadcast on network) and [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]] (broadcast on network).

Its indexed subjects and listening characteristics include hard-boiled private investigation, murder and violent crime, sponsor-era network detective radio, knockout dream and alter-ego deduction, and collector chronology and preservation conflicts.

GRH also places the series in documented historical contexts including Dick Powell creates Richard Rogue, Rogues Gallery main Mutual run, Rogues Gallery NBC summer continuations, and Surviving collector chronology contains title, date and numbering conflicts.

Programs with especially strong personnel connections in the GRH knowledge graph include [[show|lux-radio-theatre|Lux Radio Theatre]] (9 shared credited people), [[show|yours-truly-johnny-dollar|Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar]] (9 shared credited people), [[show|broadway-is-my-beat|Broadway Is My Beat]] (7 shared credited people), [[show|night-beat|Night Beat]] (7 shared credited people), and [[show|screen-directors-playhouse|Screen Directors Playhouse]] (8 shared credited people).
